US strikes Iran, oil prices pop, Goldman Sachs issues blunt warning on oil/economy; Middle East tensions escalate
Australia's inflation confirmed as 'home grown' – domestic cost pressures persist despite global commodity tailwinds
Coal boom returns as a positive for FMG.AX and BHP.AX energy segments
CSL.AX signs deal with Trump administration to slash medicine prices – margin pressure risk
Property sector under stress: Bathla developer near collapse, property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes, Sydney house prices in global crash
Top central banker warns AI could spark global economic downturn – 'contagion risk' flagged
Qantas ground crews vote for right to strike amid pay dispute; Star Entertainment blames prior management for losses
Mining exploration positives: King River 44g/t gold (WA), McLaren titanium surge, Viking tungsten, Larvotto antimony

sectors.trend: Mixed: coal boom supports FMG.AX and BHP.AX thermal coal; gold exploration (King River 44g/t, Moonlight Qld) and critical minerals (McLaren titanium, Viking tungsten, Larvotto antimony) attract speculative interest. Oil spike benefits energy names but pressures input costs.
sectors.implications: Coal and gold names see near-term upside; critical minerals remain a medium-term theme. Oil-driven inflation may delay RBA cuts, pressuring rate-sensitive miners.

sectors.trend: Bond sell-off and rising yields create headwinds for bank valuations. Property investor credit growth crash post-budget tax changes signals NPL risk for CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX. Star Entertainment (STAR.AX) in distress.
sectors.implications: Banks face margin compression from rising funding costs and property credit deterioration. STAR.AX is a near-term risk. Defensive positioning in large-cap banks warranted.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX signs Trump administration deal to slash medicine prices – significant margin headwind. Qld hospital bed backlog (1,400 patients) signals public health system strain.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX faces US pricing pressure; near-term share price risk. Domestic healthcare infrastructure names may benefit from public system investment.

sectors.trend: Oil spike on US-Iran conflict; diesel shock described as 'forever now'. Danish wind farm entrant addresses Australia's renewable drought. Tesla kills Solar Roof but benefits from US grid policy.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from oil strength. Renewable names (e.g., AGL.AX, Origin ORG.AX) see mixed signals. Diesel cost inflation pressures transport and logistics.

sectors.trend: Qantas (QAN.AX) ground crew strike vote; Jetstar launches Western Sydney Airport route. Kids clothing giant closes 29 stores. August retail shows weight-loss drug demand, dupe brands, EV uptake.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational risk from industrial action. Consumer staples under pressure from per-capita recession fears. EV and health-consumer themes show resilience.

sectors.trend: Sydney house price crash goes global; property investor credit growth crashes; Bathla developer near collapse. Negative gearing 'rent bomb' fails to ignite. Renter respite emerging.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (e.g., VMC.AX, SGH.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Residential property developers at high default risk. Rent control debate may cap yield upside.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure from oil-driven inflation, bond sell-off, and rate hike fears. Expect volatility in ^AXJO with financials and property underweight. Coal and gold names provide relative strength. Qantas strike risk adds transport sector uncertainty. 1–3 month outlook: cautious, range-bound with downside risk if oil sustains above current levels.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook hinges on RBA response to home-grown inflation and property credit trajectory. Coal boom and critical minerals offer structural support for materials. CSL US pricing deal and AI contagion risk are medium-term overhangs. Per-capita recession risk caps consumer recovery. Diversification away from concentrated index exposure advised.
